notes.title: "Project Aphotic" and "Triopticon" will be part of Steam 2025 Visual Novel Fest
notes.content:
[h2][Steam Visual Novel Fest][/h2]
[h3]"Project Aphotic" and "Triopticon" will be part of Steam's 2025 Visual Novel Fest (March 4–11). Limited-time discounts will be available during the event—stay tuned![/h3]

notes.title: 【Demo Version Discontinuation Announcement】
notes.content:
[h1]The demo version of Triopticon will remain available for download on Steam until 02/01, and the demo version of Project Aphotic will remain available until 03/01.[/h1] 
[h2]After these dates, both demo versions will no longer be accessible. The full versions of the games are unaffected, and all future updates and maintenance will focus on the full versions.
[/h2]
[h2]This decision to discontinue the demo versions is aimed at keeping the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/DarkChillDusk2024]DCD Dark Chill Dusk developer page[/url] more streamlined. Moving forward, only demo versions of games still in development will be retained.[/h2]

notes.title: Triopticon is now participating in the 2023 Steam Visual Novel Fest！
notes.content:
[h2]Triopticon is now participating in the 2023 Steam Visual Novel Fest. 
During the fest, you can enjoy an 11% discount on purchases. 
Join us and immerse yourself in the story of Triopticon.[/h2]

notes.title: English Support Updated in Triopticon三昧 v1.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]The game now includes English language support, accessible through the in-game menu (Setting) for switching between Traditional Chinese and English.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563526/839e58cdd2962a0fd75ee7b4df3383416dd189c7.gif[/img]

Please feel free to contact me if you have any suggestions.

[h3]【Triopticon三昧 1.2.0 更新】[/h3]
1) 完整版遊戲現在支援英文，可使用遊戲內選單切換英文與繁體中文。
2) UI微調。
3) 繁體中文版文本錯漏字修正。

notes.title: The Free Demo of 'Triopticon三昧' now supports English
notes.content:
[h2]Free demo version now includes English language support, accessible through the in-game menu (Setting) for switching between Traditional Chinese and English.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42563526/45dd5ae457b059d33c39d0eb9a025e6ca7c95475.gif[/img]

The full version with English support will be updated in Summer. 
Please stay tuned and feel free to contact me if you have any suggestions.


[h3]【Triopticon三昧-Demo 1.20 Update】[/h3]
1) The demo now supports English, with language switching available in the in-game menu.
2) UI refinements.
3) Correction of text errors in the Traditional Chinese version.
